title: Updates on Funding Rate Settlement Frequency of USDⓈ-M ALPACAUSDT and FLMUSDT Perpetual Contracts (2025-04-25)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will increase the funding rate settlement frequency of the following perpetual contracts as below starting from  2025-04-25 08:00 (UTC) :  USDⓈ-M ALPACAUSDT Perpetual Contract: from every two hours to  every one hour USDⓈ-M FLMUSDT Perpetual Contract: from every four hours to  every two hours The detailed arrangement is as follows: Time Max Funding Rate ALPACAUSDT Perpetual FLMUSDT Perpetual  2025-04-25 08:00 (UTC) 2025-04-25 08:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-04-25 09:00 (UTC) 2025-04-25 10:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-04-25 10:00 (UTC) 2025-04-25 12:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-04-25 11:00 (UTC) 2025-04-25 14:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … … Notes: In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M ALPACAUSDT and FLMUSDT Perpetual Contracts  without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each  margin tier , updating  funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the  Last Price Protected mechanism  to update the Mark Price. Please be noted that the last funding settlement for ALPACAUSDT will be at 2025-04-30 08:00 (UTC) due to  delisting .  For More Information: Liquidation Protocols Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Introduction to Binance Futures Funding Rates Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-04-25 Note:  This announcement was amended on 2025-04-29 to to provide details on the last funding settlement for the ALPACAUSDT Perpetual Contract.
